name: account
definition: 由金融机构开立、用于记录客户资金往来与余额的记账单元，具有唯一编号、所属地区和账单出具频率等特征 Counterexample: 与银行卡（card）不同：银行卡是账户的访问凭证，一个账户可对应多张卡；与贷款（loan）不同：贷款是账户下的一类资金合约，而非记账单元本身 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table account; provenance: direct source account

name: district
definition: 具有行政或统计边界的空间区域单元，具有唯一编号、名称、所属大区及人口统计等特征 Counterexample: 与地址（address）不同：地区是统计与行政划分的集合，地址是具体到门牌的位置描述；与银行网点不同：网点是服务机构，地区是地理划分 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table district; provenance: direct source district

name: client
definition: 在金融机构登记注册、具有性别与出生日期等身份属性并归属某一地区的自然人主体 Counterexample: 与账户（account）不同：客户是自然人主体，账户是其持有的金融记账单元；与持卡人不同：持卡人强调对卡的持有，客户强调在机构登记的身份 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table client; provenance: direct source client

name: disp
definition: 记录某一客户对某一账户所拥有的支配权限及其类型的关联实体，具有唯一编号、客户、账户与支配类型等特征 Counterexample: 与账户（account）不同：账户是记账单元，支配权是客户与账户之间的权限关系记录；与交易（trans）不同：交易是资金变动事件，支配权是权限授予状态 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table disp; provenance: direct source disp

name: card
definition: 由金融机构发行、绑定到某一账户支配权、用于取现或支付的实体凭证，具有唯一编号、卡类型与发卡日期等特征 Counterexample: 与账户（account）不同：账户是资金记账单元，卡是访问该账户的物理凭证；与信用卡不同：卡类型由 type 区分，不能一概而论 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table card; provenance: direct source card

name: loan
definition: 金融机构向账户持有人发放、约定金额、期限与还款计划并具有状态的资金融通合约 Counterexample: 与交易（trans）不同：交易是单次资金变动，贷款是跨期合约；与账户（account）不同：账户是记账单元，贷款是挂在账户下的合约 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table loan; provenance: direct source loan

name: order
definition: 由账户持有人发起、指定收款银行与收款账号及金额的转账支付指令，具有唯一编号与用途标识等特征 Counterexample: 与交易（trans）不同：交易是已发生的资金变动记录，汇款指令是发起的支付请求；与贷款不同：贷款是资金融通合约，汇款指令是支付行为 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table order; provenance: direct source order

name: trans
definition: 在某一账户上于特定时间发生、引起余额变动的资金往来事件，具有唯一编号、类型、操作方式、金额与交易后余额等特征 Counterexample: 与汇款指令（order）不同：交易是已发生的资金变动事件，汇款指令是发起的支付请求；与贷款不同：贷款是跨期合约，交易是单次资金变动 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table trans; provenance: direct source trans

name: FemaleClient
definition: 性别为女性的客户

name: MaleClient
definition: 性别为男性的客户

name: BirthDate
definition: 客户出生日期,用于计算年龄或筛选出生年份

name: District
definition: 账户所属地区/分支,名称记录在 district.A2

name: Region
definition: 地区所属大区名称,记录在 district.A3

name: NumInhabitants
definition: 地区居民人数,记录在 district.A4

name: AvgSalary
definition: 地区平均工资,记录在 district.A11

name: UnemploymentRate1995
definition: 1995 年地区失业率,记录在 district.A12

name: UnemploymentRate1996
definition: 1996 年地区失业率,记录在 district.A13

name: Crimes1995
definition: 1995 年地区犯罪数量,记录在 district.A15

name: RunningLoan
definition: 状态为 C(正常履约)或 D(欠款)的未结清贷款

name: LoanAmount
definition: 贷款金额

name: CreditCardWithdrawal
definition: 信用卡取现交易,operation 为 VYBER KARTOU

name: IssuanceAfterTransaction
definition: 交易后出账的账户频率类型

name: GoldCard
definition: 金卡级别的信用卡

name: AccountOwner
definition: 账户所有者身份的处置关系

name: Account
definition: 银行账户

name: TransactionAmount
definition: 交易金额
aliases: amount is less than the average

name: MaleClientPercentage
definition: 男性客户占全部客户的比例 Formula: MaleClient / (MaleClient + FemaleClient) * 100. Inputs: MaleClient = client.gender WHERE gender = 'M'; FemaleClient = client.gender WHERE gender = 'F'

name: SalaryGap
definition: 最高与最低地区平均工资之差 Formula: MAX(AvgSalary) - MIN(AvgSalary). Inputs: AvgSalary = district.A11
aliases: gap between lowest and highest average salary

name: UnemploymentIncrementRate
definition: 1995 到 1996 年失业率的增长百分比 Formula: (UnemploymentRate1996 - UnemploymentRate1995) / UnemploymentRate1995 * 100. Inputs: UnemploymentRate1995 = district.A12; UnemploymentRate1996 = district.A13

name: AvgRunningLoanAmount
definition: 未结清贷款的平均金额 Formula: AVG(LoanAmount) WHERE RunningLoan. Inputs: LoanAmount = loan.amount; RunningLoan = loan.status WHERE status IN ('C','D')
aliases: average amount of loan still running

name: RunningLoanCount
definition: 未结清贷款合同数量 Formula: COUNT(loan_id) WHERE RunningLoan. Inputs: RunningLoan = loan.status WHERE status IN ('C','D')

name: FemaleAccountHolderCount
definition: 女性账户持有者数量 Formula: COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) WHERE FemaleClient. Inputs: FemaleClient = client.gender WHERE gender = 'F'; Account = account.account_id

name: AvgCrimes1995
definition: 1995 年地区平均犯罪数量 Formula: AVG(Crimes1995). Inputs: Crimes1995 = district.A15

name: CreditCardWithdrawalAvgAmount
definition: 信用卡取现交易的平均金额 Formula: AVG(TransactionAmount) WHERE CreditCardWithdrawal. Inputs: CreditCardWithdrawal = trans.operation WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'; TransactionAmount = trans.amount

name: ClientAge
definition: 客户年龄,由出生日期推算 Formula: YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - YEAR(BirthDate). Inputs: BirthDate = client.birth_date

name: GoldCardOwnerCount
definition: 持有金卡且为账户所有者的客户数 Formula: COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) WHERE GoldCard AND AccountOwner. Inputs: GoldCard = card.type WHERE type = 'gold'; AccountOwner = disp.type WHERE type = 'OWNER'

name: DistrictFemaleAccountCount
definition: 按地区统计的女性账户持有者数量 Formula: COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) WHERE FemaleClient GROUP BY District. Inputs: FemaleClient = client.gender WHERE gender = 'F'; District = district.A2

name: LoanToAccountRatio
definition: 每个账户的平均贷款数 Formula: COUNT(loan_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT account_id). Inputs: RunningLoan = loan.status WHERE status IN ('C','D'); Account = account.account_id

name: LoanStatus
definition: 贷款合同状态,用于识别未结清、正常履约或欠款贷款

name: CardType
definition: 信用卡等级类型

name: DispType
definition: 客户与账户的处置关系类型

name: AccountFrequency
definition: 账户对账单出具频率

name: TransactionOperation
definition: 交易操作类型

name: TransactionType
definition: 交易借贷方向类型

name: TransactionKSymbol
definition: 交易用途分类代码

name: OrderKSymbol
definition: 汇款指令用途分类代码
